XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Bodywork

  • Device: - -

  • Fault: Central locking via remote control not functioning. When the remote control is pressed, the indicators flash normally, but the doors do not open or close.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis:
  • B102A (Fault - Lock relay, door locks)
  • B1029 (Fault - Unlock relay, door locks)
  • B102B (Fault - Lock relay, load compartment)
  • Cause: Damaged wires in the tailgate wiring harness

• Action: Proceed with the restoration of the wiring on the tailgate.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The wiring in question is located inside a cable duct on the tailgate, on the passenger side, accessible after removing the duct itself. Following the repair of the wires, the problem was definitively resolved.
